newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eridania rises on better costs outlook.
newsitem.headline: Eridania rises on better costs outlook.

text.p: Shares in Eridania Beghin-Say jumped on Wednesday, helped mostly by prospects of cheaper raw material prices, dealers said.
At 1441 GMT the stock was up 1.90 percent to 804 francs in a volume of 97,172 shares.

On Tuesday Spain's biggest olive oil producer Koipe SA, part of the Eridania group, predicted rocketing olive prices were set to ease in the early months of 1997 after the new crop hits the market. Eridania controls 16 percent of the world olive oil market.
A five-year drought sent olive supplies to a 13-year low, driving olive and olive oil prices to record highs and slashing consumption.
Eridania is also benefiting from lower prices for wheat and maize in the face of ample supply in the European Union and in most of the world's key grain suppliers.
Traders also said optimistic prospects for the food ingredients sector were helping the share.
Interestingly the comments on the ingredient sector were made by rival group Saint-Louis, which held an analysts' meeting earlier in the day.
